definitions.gloss: middle blessing; a moderately good fortune (on an omikuji)
definitions.explanation: A fortune level on an {御神籤|おみくじ} (paper fortune drawn at shrines and temples), ranking below {大吉|だいきち} (great blessing) and above {小吉|しょうきち} (small blessing).

examples.japanese: おみくじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{中吉|ちゅうきち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: I drew a middle blessing on the omikuji.

examples.japanese: ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{引|ひ}いた→引く：01978_hiku⟧おみくじ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{中吉|ちゅうきち}だった。
examples.english: The fortune I drew on my New Year's shrine visit was a middle blessing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大吉|だいきち}→大吉：19336_daikichi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{中吉|ちゅうきち}だった⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦まあまあ→まあまあ：05430_maamaa⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{年|とし}→年：00486_toshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧そうだ。
examples.english: It wasn't a great blessing, but it was a middle blessing, so this year looks like it will be a fairly good one.

notes:
A middling-good fortune drawn on an おみくじ. A common ranking, best to worst, is ⟦{大吉|だいきち}→大吉：19336_daikichi⟧ → {中吉|ちゅうきち} → ⟦{小吉|しょうきち}→小吉：29073_shoukichi⟧ → ⟦{吉|きち}→吉：19344_kichi⟧ → ⟦{末吉|すえきち}→末吉：29074_suekichi⟧ → ⟦{凶|きょう}→凶：19345_kyou⟧, though the exact order varies by shrine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中吉|ちゅうきち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧: to draw a middle blessing
- おみくじ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{中吉|ちゅうきち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧: to pull a middle blessing on a fortune slip
